# @appolabs/appo

> The Appo CLI: turn a website into native iOS and Android apps and publish them on the App Store and Google Play, from the terminal or an agent.

A thin, dependency-free Node client over the Appo public API (`/api/v1`) and the
RFC 8628 device-authorization grant. One command takes a website to an app on a
phone: `appo start <url>` (or `appo new <url>`); `appo ship` puts the app on the
stores. An AI agent can run the CLI or use the remote MCP connector,
`https://apps.goappo.io/mcp`, which `appo mcp` registers.

## Guided flow (agents)

`appo start <url>` is the one command: it creates the app when the address is new,
then asks what the server still needs and ends with the link to open the app on a
phone. `appo install <url>` is the same session stopped at the link; `appo new <url>`
always creates. Answer flags: `--fix self|appo`, `--phone iphone|android`,
`--iphone direct|testflight`, `--appo-help yes|no`, plus `--owner-authorized
--accept-tos` at creation.

Under `--json` or without a terminal a question still waiting for an answer is not
asked: the command prints an `input_required` envelope and exits 2. Its code is
`decision_required` (details.answers lists each answer with the flags that give it)
or `attestation_required` (consent flags missing; nothing is created, no request is
issued). An agent asks the user the question, as separate steps, and must not choose
the flags itself; then it re-runs with the flags the envelope names. See
[appo new](README.md#appo-new).

- [appo env list / env use](README.md#environments)
- [appo apps list / apps show / apps check / apps update](README.md#apps)
- [appo status](README.md#status): app overview; the install line is the readiness answer
- [appo run, apps create, publish](README.md#kept-for-scripts): older forms kept for scripts
- [appo rejection](README.md#rejection)
- [appo fix-recipe](README.md#fix-recipe)
- [appo publish](README.md#publish): the publish step `ship` wraps
- [appo push](README.md#push)
- [appo suggest](README.md#suggest): what Appo found on the site and how the web view behaves
- [appo customize](README.md#customize): read or write your block of injected CSS and JavaScript (dry run without --confirm)
- [appo apps remove](README.md#apps-remove): remove an app that was never published (dry run without --confirm)
- [appo testflight](README.md#testflight): send a new build to TestFlight (needs --confirm)
- [appo download](README.md#download)
- [appo devices list / devices register](README.md#devices)
- [appo mcp](README.md#mcp)
